title: Mechanism-level unseen audit and persistence-controlled learnability

gates.name: audit_correctness
gates.rule: task-level audit really works at task scale (T-AUDIT-01..06)

gates.name: u3_u4v2_unseen_validity
gates.rule: mechanism-level U3 + task/event-level distributional U4-v2 novelty

stop_table.STOP-0: task-level audit correctness FAIL -> no formal data generation
stop_table.STOP-A2: U3/U4-v2 FAIL -> no unseen model experiment
stop_table.STOP-B2: onset learnability / permutation FAIL -> no C/D tuning
stop_table.STOP-CAP: fixed residual upper bound shows no gain -> no online grid, no D
stop_table.STOP-C2: strict online C not better than A -> no D
stop_table.STOP-D0: additive continuity FAIL -> no D effectiveness run
stop_table.STOP-D1: D has no independent benefit -> cannot claim dynamic experts work
stop_table.STOP-R: recurrence reuse FAIL -> add-only claim only

forbidden: retrain offline v4 / P19 / P20 checkpoints

registered_seeds.note: frozen before the first formal generation; the confirm seed is not used in round 1

resource_discipline.exit_code_source: subprocess returncode, never a PowerShell wrapper

honesty_rules: STOP outcomes are experimental results and must be reported with evidence.
No gate threshold may be redefined after seeing candidate results.
Offline percentiles are locked before any candidate is read.
Model scores may never influence which probability passes U4-v2.
History is never rewritten: P21 STOP-A stays FAIL.
